newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes up at new 20-month high vs US dollar.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes up at new 20-month high vs US dollar.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed up at a new 20-month high of 8.2928 against the U.S. dollar in Shanghai on Friday from Thursday's 8.2938 on active demand ahead of the Chinese lunar new year holiday, traders said.
The previous high was also 8.2928, set on May 19, 1995.
Dealers said the yuan continued last week's upward trend with the central bank intervening less than normal to cap pro-yuan sentiment.
The yuan opened slightly lower at 8.2940 and consolidated up to move between 8.2930 and 8.2935 for most of the session, hitting an intraday low of 8.2960 and a high of 8.2920.
